existing_recovery_suite: Frozen 60 validation fragments; 39 Python, 21 Rust and 0 C++; do not alter cases or thresholds.

complexity_definition.intermediate: Not basic; node count <= 150 and depth <= 10

revision_policy: Every admitted source revision must be a full immutable Git commit ID (40-64 lowercase hexadecimal characters); branch names and abbreviated commits are rejected.
clone_family_policy: Each case clone_family must match the independently curated source registry. Case-local clone labels do not establish lineage.
split_rules: Freeze approved source revision and license before acquisition.
Keep repository, file and verified clone-family groups disjoint across splits.
Run exact and near-duplicate benchmark contamination checks against fingerprinted training sources.
Treat missing source lineage, clone-family evidence or language coverage as unknown and block the multilingual claim.
test_access: No test content or predictions are used for model selection.
evidence_boundary: Pinned Python/Rust/C++ validation repositories are materialized, parser/action replayed, and coverage-audited. Exact and substring matches are excluded and recorded. Near-overlap is unassessed for fragments shorter than 64 characters; external benchmark scanning remains deferred until candidate identity freeze. This is not model capability evidence.
